import runpy, signal, sys
m=runpy.run_path(sys.argv[1], run_name='diagnostic_signal_smoke')
m['alarm_handler'](signal.SIGTERM, None)
try:
    m['tick']()
except m['BudgetExceeded'] as exc:
    print('EXPECTED_LATCHED_STOP:', str(exc))
else:
    raise SystemExit('signal was not consumed by tick')
m['alarm_handler'](signal.SIGINT, None)
m['finish']('SIMULATED_SETTLEMENT_AFTER_LATCH')
scope: Import only this exact read-only diagnostic without invoking main; manually deliver SIGTERM/SIGINT to handler, require tick raises BudgetExceeded and result emission works afterward. No real process kill and no scientific evidence.
